Optional RTL8188EU HT20/LGI MCS0-7 requires a separate signed measured rtl8xxxu/rtl8188eu-ht20-lgi-v1-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin N8HT record bound to the exact N8PC legacy qualification, USB/factory identity, actual uploaded executable and EU-specific program. The retained RTL8188EE channel1/basic1Mbps Open/WPA2 station requires signed measured rtlwifi/rtl8188ee-cal-v1-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin matching the factory identity and current power envelope; physical qualification remains required. Other rtlwifi chips remain gated.

Optional RTL8188EE HT20/LGI MCS0-7 requires a separate signed measured rtlwifi/rtl8188ee-ht20-lgi-v1-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin NEHT record, bound to the exact preceding NEPC file, full factory identity, uploaded rtlwifi/rtl8188efw.bin digest and native recipe supplied by ht20_request(). Stage it while parked before the first packet owner starts; no legacy qualification grants HT. These dynamic per-device records are external requirements, not fixed payloads checked by this catalog.
Production NRFW signatures/trusted keys and deployment wireless-regulatory.bin policy are provisioned separately; payload presence grants no TX authority.

RTL8821CE's retained native station requires its own signed per-device IQK, operating-power and N21S station qualifications. Optional legacy-WMM, HT20, recipient BA, sender BA and RTS profiles require their distinct N21L/N21H/N21R/N21T/N21X measured records under rtw88/rtw8821ce-<profile>-v1-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin; request APIs supply the exact names and current recipe identities. RTL8822CE artifacts cannot substitute for this chip.
Production NRFW signatures/trusted keys and deployment wireless-regulatory.bin policy are provisioned separately; payload presence grants no TX authority.

The retained RTL8822CE channel1/basic1Mbps Open/WPA2 station requires signed measured rtw88/rtw8822ce-cal-v2-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin covering calibration and autonomous response power; v1 does not qualify this profile. Physical qualification and other rtw88 chips remain open.

Optional legacy-WMM, HT20, recipient BA, sender BA and RTS additionally require distinct N22L/N22H/N22R/N22T/N22X measured records. The RTS request names rtw88/rtw8822ce-rts-v1-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin and binds the exact H, R or T program. Old profile records grant no broader RTS/BA authority; request APIs and the family specification define the complete source chain.

The retained RTL8852B channel1/basic1Mbps Open/WPA2 station requires both signed measured rtw89/rtw8852b-cal-v1-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin and rtw89/rtw8852b-radio-v2-<factory MAC lowercase hex>.bin bound to actual firmware PHY capability and full calibration/operating/autonomous-response power. Match physical cut/non-manufacturing suit and qualify actual RF.
